title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
description: Cauliflower florets baked in a light, crisp batter and tossed in a tangy butter and hot sauce glaze. Spicy, messy and hard to stop eating.

image.alt: Cauliflower bites tossed in orange buffalo sauce with celery

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 450F oven} and line the sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, garlic powder, paprika, salt and water into a smooth batter like thin pancake batter. Toss the florets in it until coated.
Spread the florets on the sheet, letting extra batter drip off, with space between them. Bake until the coating is dry and lightly golden, {time 20 min}.
Whisk the hot sauce and melted butter. Toss the baked florets in it, spread them out again and bake until the glaze sets and the edges crisp, {time 10-15 min}.
Serve right away with celery sticks and your favorite dip.

notes: Use vegan butter or olive oil in the sauce to make this vegan.
Swap the flour for a gluten-free blend if you need to, and check your hot sauce label.
